1.0.1.en: Connect your Alfen charger and use Homey for loadbalancing

1.1.0.en: Deleted double flows, adjustment of app image and app description

1.1.2.en: adjust minimum A to charge lower then 6A

1.1.3.en: add solar loading mode for charging EV only if >2A power goes to grid

1.2.0.en: extension of solar charge function and set minimum charge power if solarcharge is active

1.2.1.en: decrease time for reconnect measure.power reading

1.2.4.en: Disable suncharging if loadbalancing if capabilities are missing

1.2.7.en: add notification if loadbalancing succesfull is activated

1.3.0.en: add capabilities for connected car, pause and suncharging state

1.3.4.en: Total charge power is now calculated from the three phases (fixes too low power in the Energy tab). New Flow cards to turn solar surplus charging on/off and check its state.
1.3.4.nl: Totaal laadvermogen wordt nu uit de drie fasen berekend (lost te laag vermogen op het tabblad Energie op). Nieuwe Flow-kaarten om zonne-overschot laden aan/uit te zetten en de status te controleren.

1.3.6.en: add flowstatement to start en stop suncharging

1.3.7.en: More stable after updates and removing the device (no more reconnects from a removed device). New setting 'Charge power source' for chargers/firmware where charge power stayed 0 in the Energy tab. Lower load: energy meter updates are bundled, all Modbus actions run one after the other and measurements are read in one request.
1.3.7.nl: Stabieler na updates en verwijderen van het apparaat (geen reconnects meer vanuit een verwijderd apparaat). Nieuwe instelling 'Bron laadvermogen' voor palen/firmware waarbij het laadvermogen op het tabblad Energie op 0 bleef. Lagere belasting: energiemeter-updates worden gebundeld, alle Modbus-acties lopen na elkaar en meetwaarden worden in één verzoek gelezen.

1.3.8.en: smoother charging: resume at a minimum 8A

1.3.9.en: pause and minimum charge time 1 minute
